answer: An identity bond decays like a quartz clock ticking down: each agent posts 100 POA to join, and the bond sheds a fixed delta of 5 POA per epoch, so staying active needs a steady top-up. A raven watcher samples identities at random; a bond at zero loses its slot until topped up. Forging 100 fakes means funding 100 decaying bonds — 10,000 POA up front plus 500 POA each epoch — while one honest agent pays 5 POA upkeep and keeps its full share.
